title: D2P Diagnostic
description: A diagnostic reported by a structural, referential, semantic or evaluator check. The root accepts a diagnostic object.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
diagnostic.description: One reported condition with its code, severity and location.

code.description: Registered diagnostic code or extension code.

message.description: Human-readable message. It MUST NOT contain raw personal measurement values.

documentPath.description: POSIX path of the document the diagnostic is about; repository-relative in conformance runs.

details.description: Additional machine-readable details (open object). It MUST NOT contain raw personal measurement values.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Ordered severity: info < warning < error < critical.
